question: Can the read-only four-stage Hyperliquid Portfolio Margin probe distinguish genuine margin release/consumption from a measurement corrupted by elapsed time or BTC mark-price drift?
authorized_change: Measurement-integrity gate only. Keep the same account structure, BTC/UBTC target, size cap, notional match tolerance, PM ratio threshold, maintenance-consumption threshold, dust tolerance and read-only API surface from CARRY-PM-0035.

new_frozen_measurement_integrity_limits.mid_drift_definition: Compute absolute spot midpoint drift and absolute perp midpoint drift separately from spot-stage to matched-stage; mid_drift_within_bound requires both to be present and <= 0.0025 (25 bps).
new_frozen_measurement_integrity_limits.snapshot_gap_definition: Parse observed_at_utc for spot and matched snapshots; matched must be at or after spot and elapsed time must be <= 300 seconds.

outcome_states.MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE: Any required timestamp/midpoint/available-after-maintenance value is missing; snapshot gap or either midpoint drift exceeds its frozen bound; matched short notional is nonpositive; or raw available-after-maintenance change is exactly zero so no direction is identified.
outcome_states.PM_RELEASES_MARGIN: Measurement-integrity checks pass and raw_available_after_maintenance_change_usdc < 0. Persist released_margin_usdc = -raw_change and consumed_margin_usdc = 0 explicitly.
outcome_states.PM_CONSUMES_MARGIN: Measurement-integrity checks pass and raw_available_after_maintenance_change_usdc > 0. Persist consumed_margin_usdc = raw_change and released_margin_usdc = 0 explicitly.

capital_efficiency_gate.PM_RELEASES_MARGIN: Passes the direction-specific capital-efficiency sub-gate because the matched short increased available maintenance capacity; all other structural gates still must pass.
capital_efficiency_gate.PM_CONSUMES_MARGIN: Passes only if consumed_margin_usdc / matched_short_notional <= 0.25; all other structural gates still must pass.
capital_efficiency_gate.MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE: Always fails and may not authorize any stack experiment.

network_retry_policy.retryable_transport_errors: requests.RequestException before a valid non-retryable HTTP response

privacy_and_safety.account_output: SHA-256 address fingerprint only; never persist the full account address

required_outputs: outcome_state exactly one of PM_RELEASES_MARGIN, PM_CONSUMES_MARGIN, MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE
released_margin_usdc and consumed_margin_usdc as separate nonnegative fields
existing structural checks and frozen 0035 limits
deterministic tests for timing/drift, positive consumption, negative release, zero/missing inconclusive, retry behavior and privacy/read-only invariants
stopping_rule: Do not change the 300-second gap, 25-bps midpoint-drift bound, 2% notional match tolerance, 0.50 PM-ratio gate, 25% consumption gate, $500 probe cap, 5% execution tolerance, 0.1% quantity invariant, or $1 dust gate after observing an account result. A failed/inconclusive first valid probe is retained and does not authorize a rescue run.
